settings.text:
Disney Destinations - Book with Mr Chocolate's Travel : Australia's Disney Experts

These parks located all over the world make it easier for most people to experience the magic of Disney. This includes Disneyland in California, Walt Disney World in Orlando, Hong Kong Disneyland, Shanghai Disneyland, Disneyland Paris, and Tokyo Disneyland.

settings.heading: Disneyland (CA)
settings.text: Discover the original Disney magic at Disneyland Resort, California. Featuring Disneyland Park and Disney California Adventure, it offers a blend of classic attractions and innovative experiences like Star Wars: Galaxy’s Edge. Ideal for families, with seasonal events and the vibrant Downtown Disney for shopping and dining.

settings.heading: Walt Disney World Resort (FL)
settings.text: Explore the vast Walt Disney World Resort in Florida, encompassing four theme parks and two water parks. Highlights include Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Disney’s Hollywood Studios, and Disney’s Animal Kingdom, along with Disney Springs for additional entertainment.

settings.heading: Tokyo Disney Resort
settings.text: Experience a unique Disney blend at Tokyo Disney Resort, Japan. It features Tokyo Disneyland and Tokyo DisneySea, offering exclusive attractions and seasonal events. A perfect mix of Disney charm and Japanese culture.

settings.heading: Hong Kong Disneyland
settings.text: Hong Kong Disneyland Resort combines Disney magic with cultural diversity. Seven themed lands, including exclusive attractions like Mystic Manor and Iron Man Experience, offer a unique, intimate Disney experience.

settings.heading: Disneyland Paris
settings.text: Delight in the fairy-tale magic at Disneyland Paris. Comprising Disneyland Park and Walt Disney Studios Park, it offers a European twist on Disney adventures, with iconic attractions and seasonal festivals.

settings.heading: Shanghai Disneyland
settings.text: Welcome to a never-before-seen world of wonder where you can ignite the magical dream within your heart. This is Shanghai Disneyland, a fun experience filled with creativity, adventure, and thrills for Guests of all ages.
